summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of the cipher-box project end-to-end, including wave-based plan execution, security review, code quality review, UAT, and shipping a PR.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified (6/6 VAULT requirements met). Multiple bugs discovered and fixed during UAT including v2 blob handling in folder sync, recovery tool IPNS resolution, security bounds checks, and a duplicate HKDF derivation. PR #344 created and merge conflicts resolved.

repo: The project uses a GSD (Get Shit Done) workflow system with wave-based parallel subagent execution, checkpoints, and automated verification.
orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields in OpenAPI specs — `as unknown as string` casts are the intentional workaround.
IPFS runs at 192.168.133.114:8080 (gateway) and 5001 (API). Port 8080 supports CORS (*), port 5001 does not. The /ipns/{name} gateway path resolves IPNS AND returns content in one request.
NestJS does not auto-log incoming request routes, making it appear that POST /vault/migrate was never called when it actually was. The database is the source of truth.
The CipherBox API's IPNS resolve endpoint requires JWT auth — the recovery tool cannot use it without authentication.
Subfolder IPNS records are only stored in the CipherBox API DB cache and are not propagated to the public DHT, limiting offline recovery to root-level folders.
The project working directory for phase 20 was cipher-box-phase-20 (separate from cipher-box), causing the initial gsd-tools init to fail.

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without checking for v2 binary format header, crashing with 'Unexpected token' on migrated vaults.
Same v2 blob parsing bug as folder.service.ts — needed detectBlobVersion + deserializeVaultBlobV2 before JSON.parse.
fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-404 gateway failures (502/503), causing detectBlobVersion to crash on undefined.length. Added explicit error throw.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 had no key length bounds check — wrappedKey could silently truncate to u16 max. Changed return type to Result<Vec<u8>, VaultBlobError>.
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, which would print encrypted key material. Replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields.
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs. Hoisted derivation above try/catch and reused result.
Desktop vault init double-wrapped rootFolderKey with ECIES — once for DB, once for v2 blob. Fixed to reuse the first wrap.
IPNS resolution now uses HEAD request to /ipns/{name} on the IPFS gateway to extract CID from X-Ipfs-Roots header, bypassing delegated routing API CBOR parsing issues entirely.

workflow: The gsd-debug workflow is valuable even when the 'bug' turns out to be a false alarm — it confirmed the migration succeeded by querying the database directly.
Security review (security:review command) should run after phase execution and before checkpoint approval on crypto-heavy phases.
Playwright MCP is useful for browser console inspection and UI testing during UAT checkpoints.
When NestJS API calls appear missing from logs, always check the database before assuming failure — NestJS doesn't log routes by default.
The /ipns/{name} IPFS gateway path is superior to delegated routing APIs for recovery tools because it resolves IPNS and fetches content in one request with CORS support.

friction: gsd-tools init failed initially because phase 20 was in cipher-box-phase-20 directory, not cipher-box — required manual directory detection.
NestJS silent request logging caused a lengthy debugging session (Playwright login, DB query, log analysis) to confirm /vault/migrate had actually been called.
orval codegen generates wrong types for nullable strings — requires `as unknown as string` casts that look like bugs but are the only workaround.

Recovery tool IPNS resolution went through 5+ iterations (delegated routing, Kubo API, CipherBox API proxy, gateway /ipns/ HEAD) before finding a working approach due to CORS and DHT propagation issues.
API ConnectionRefused error interrupted the security review command on first attempt, requiring a second invocation.
Merge conflicts in ROADMAP.md required multiple edit passes to fully resolve — one stray conflict marker survived the initial cleanup.
open_items: Recovery tool subfolder traversal fails when subfolder IPNS records haven't propagated to the public DHT — deferred to later phase.
Recovery tool improvements generally deferred (all recovery bugs found during UAT noted as 'can happen at a later date').
E2E tests for vault v2 recovery tool (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-add-e2e-tests-for-vault-v2-recovery-tool.md).
Device registry sync fails with 'CryptoError: Invalid registry format' — pre-existing schema mismatch (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-fix-device-registry-cryptoerror-invalid-registry-format.md).
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing issue (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-fix-bin-ipns-name-404-resolution-failure.md).

Security review medium issues: recovery tool private key not zeroed after use (M-1), no dedup guard on concurrent migration from multiple tabs (M-2), unnecessary ECIES re-wrap on every root folder publish in FUSE (M-3).
Security review low issues: zero-length key accepted by deserializers (L-1), no SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html (L-2).
PR #344 CodeRabbit review comments not yet addressed (PR was just created at end of session).
